item.title: Patch now: Critical Node-RED Flaw Exploited in Attacks
item.description:
Siemens SIMATIC (several versions): RCE · pre-auth · internet-facing · exploited (news only) · fix: V4.3.4-1

First step: Update the affected Siemens products to V4.3.4-1 or later.

A vulnerability has been identified in SIMATIC IoT2050 Advanced (6ES7647-0BA00-1YA2) (All versions < V4.3.4-1 running Industrial OS with Node-RED installed), SIMATIC IoT2050 Basic (6ES7647-0BA00-0YA2) (All versions < V4.3.4-1 running Industrial OS with Node-RED installed), SIMATIC IoT2050 M.2 (6ES7647-0BB00-1YA2) (All versions < V4.3.4-1 running Industrial OS with Node-RED installed), SIMATIC IoT2050 SM…

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-58115

item.title: Patch: Siemens Software Center: Uncontrolled Search Path Element
item.description:
Siemens Software Center: RCE · admin required · local access · exploited · fix: V4.0.9.8

First step: Update Siemens Software Center to V4.0.9.8 or later.

Siemens Software Center contains an uncontrolled search path element vulnerability that could allow an authenticated local attacker to place a specially crafted DLL in a directory that the application searches, leading to arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the affected application.

Medium · Fix available · CVE-2026-110936
